blocks.text: Buying a Home in Greendale, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Greendale

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Yale Road West, Sumas Prairie Road, Lickman Road, South Sumas Road, and Highway 1 Exits 109 (Yale Road West) and 116 (Lickman Road). Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Greendale will find small rural acreages (1 to 10 acres), commercial dairy, poultry, berry, and forage farms (10+ acres) in the ALR, and rural single-family homes along Sumas Prairie Road and Yale Road West. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Greendale Neighbourhood Guide

Families looking at homes for sale in Greendale are served by Greendale Elementary Community School (K–5 at 6625 Sumas Prairie Road), Unsworth Elementary, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include the Great Blue Heron Nature Reserve (325 hectares of wetland trails and rotary interpretive centre on Sumas Prairie Road), Vedder Canal dikes and fishing trails, and Greendale Community Park. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 55 (Yarrow–Greendale loop Monday through Saturday) and commuter highway access via Exit 109 and Exit 116.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Greendale

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Greendale are regulated by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, the City's Agricultural Area Plan, Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) house-size and farm-use rules, and Vedder/Fraser floodplain construction levels. Before removing subjects on a property in Greendale, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our

What types of homes are for sale in Greendale?

Active MLS® listings in Greendale typically include small rural acreages (1 to 10 acres), commercial dairy, poultry, berry, and forage farms (10+ acres) in the ALR, and rural single-family homes along Sumas Prairie Road and Yale Road West. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Greendale in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Greendale include Greendale Elementary Community School (K–5 at 6625 Sumas Prairie Road), Unsworth Elementary, Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Greendale?

Residents of Greendale have access to the Great Blue Heron Nature Reserve (325 hectares of wetland trails and rotary interpretive centre on Sumas Prairie Road), Vedder Canal dikes and fishing trails, and Greendale Community Park. See our
Greendale Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Greendale?

Key road corridors serving Greendale include Yale Road West, Sumas Prairie Road, Lickman Road, South Sumas Road, and Highway 1 Exits 109 (Yale Road West) and 116 (Lickman Road). Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 55 (Yarrow–Greendale loop Monday through Saturday) and commuter highway access via Exit 109 and Exit 116.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Greendale?

Properties in Greendale are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan, the City's Agricultural Area Plan, Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) house-size and farm-use rules, and Vedder/Fraser floodplain construction levels. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Greendale freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Greendale are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
